question: In Slack: Add a rocket reaction to the release message that already has both eyes from Priya and white_check_mark from Diego.
final:
Done. 🚀

There were 3 identical "Release v2.4 is live." messages in #launch, so I checked the reactions on each — the right one is the latest (ts `1789990800.000003`), which already had Priya's 👀 and Diego's ✅. I added the 🚀 reaction there and verified it's showing alongside the other two.
